$comment: Surveys the execution tests run against. key: unique name (use with SURVEY_KEY=key). testId: catalog ID the result is reported under. url: respondent link. answers (optional): questionLabel -> option labels to pin; every other question is answered randomly (seeded). enabled: false skips it unless selected with SURVEY_KEY.

surveys.description: MC questions, fixed answers for the labelled ones, random for the rest
